name: BBC 2LO daily radio service
description: Regular radio broadcasts by the British Broadcasting Company from its London 2LO studio, accessible to listeners with receiving equipment and a licence.

date.label: 14 November 1922
date.basis: Date or interval stated or closely scoped by the cited source; see event caveats.

events.statement: Daily broadcasting from 2LO in London began on 14 November 1922, with Birmingham and Manchester broadcasts following the next day.

evidence.supports: Identifies the company and daily transmissions.
BBC history dates the regular broadcasts and identifies the operator.

date.label: by 1926
date.basis: BBC history says the reported number existed by 1926; it does not date when the threshold was reached.

events.statement: The BBC history reports 2.25 million radio licences by 1926.
events.caveats: Licences are not individual listeners, households reached, or a verified population denominator.

evidence.supports: The BBC retrospective gives the licence count.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest cited dated event for this scoped record; a surviving witness or publication is not itself the invention date.

date.label: 1 November 1922
date.basis: Date or interval stated or closely scoped by the cited source; see event caveats.

measures.subject: Broadcast receiving licence
measures.money_context: Nominal British price; source says fee introduced on 1 November 1922 and half went to BBC. Duration and purchasing power are not specified here.
measures.conditions: Licence fee stated by BBC historical retrospective; it excludes receiver cost.

measures.subject: Broadcast receiving licences
measures.conditions: BBC retrospective says 2.25 million licences by 1926; not a count of people or households.

caveats: This British service was not the first radio broadcast anywhere; its organisation changed from company to corporation in 1927.

research.note: Second reader checked the BBC historical PDF. Its 2.25 million licence count is bounded by 1926, and the fee is a nominal price, not receiver cost.

impact.note: Regular broadcasts reached one national society and expanded to later services.

tier_reason: Provisional judgment of sourced consequences, following docs/importance.md; independent review required.
